summary: Vendor the pty Cargo git crates from the pinned pty flake input

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change; the vendored crate sources are byte-identical (same NAR hash).

manual.detail: Nix builds now take the pty git crates from the archive-backed pty flake input instead of fetching them with git, so building no longer needs anonymous git access to GitHub. Evaluation fails if Cargo.lock's pty revision differs from the flake input, so bump both together.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
